## Appearance

Elizabeth Russell was known to possess great beauty in her youth.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)_

## Personality

Elizabeth Russell is a clever and fundamentally nice individual, though she possesses an awful temper that she sometimes manages through extreme physical outlets. She maintains a mirthful disposition while simultaneously dwelling largely in the past.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P4](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0004)_

## History

During her youth, Elizabeth Russell visited her uncle, a government official, in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) during the year the Prince of Wales visited the [Island](../codex/places.md#island), where she was invited to a great ball and danced with the Prince as the prettiest girl there. A year or so after [Ned Russell](../character/ned-russell.md) married, she moved in to live with him and his bride as a creature of mirth, later remodeling the house's fireplace fifteen years ago. She ultimately chose never to marry because she feared her own bad temper would prevent her from living peaceably with any man.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P25](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)_
